sample.title: REAL: four-stage chain, Spark text -> Muse Image -> SAM 3.1 -> Spark vision (recorded 2026-11-02, scored 2026-11-03)
sample.description: Four-stage chain with three named Meta tools (Muse Spark, Muse Image, SAM 3.1). Steps 1 to 4 replay recorded run s1 (notification preferences with toggle switches and top tabs), recorded on 2026-11-02: Muse Spark text wrote the image prompt, Muse Image generated the UI screenshot, SAM 3.1 proposed 12 boxes over 4 phrases (HTTP 200 each), Muse Spark pure vision named all 12 numbered marks. Step 5 is the earlier 3-run footer, counts only. Steps 6 and 7 show MEASURED numbers from a later run on 24 synthetic AI-generated screenshots (exploratory, one seed, self-registered before the first model call) and a separately labelled post-hoc re-run; receipts IA-*. Replay only: steps replay recorded data and make no live model calls.
chain: Muse Spark text writes the image prompt
Muse Image generates the UI screenshot
Muse Spark vision names each numbered mark
Earlier run footer (3 runs, counts only)
Label recall on 24 synthetic images (MEASURED, IA-*)
Post-hoc re-run of the 4 failed images (NOT pre-registered, IA-*)
